title: Larger companies or small ones ?
text:
# Part 1
I prefer working in a large company / rather than a small one.
There are several reasons / to support my opinion.

# Part 2
First of all,/ large companies usually offer more opportunities for promotion.
If there are more opportunities,/ young people are more likely to dedicate their time and effort /to the company.

# Part 3
Secondly,/ large companies usually have clearer training systems.
If employees receive clearer training,/ they are more likely to work more efficiently and productively.

# Part 3.5
Thirdly,/ large companies usually provide better benefits / and a more stable working environment. 

# Part 4
That’s why / I prefer working in a large company.
